text:
arian: sketching a 'quick-palette' for contingency actions  small grid of presets (soft, quarantine, fallback-model, divert) with icons. goal: visual, fast, and auditable. feedback? :paintbrush:
pavel: I like a palette instead of a single-row dropdown. Operators can pick an icon and preset. But we still need explicit scope (rollout/route) and a confirm step for escalations.
sara: Yes show route + rollout id prominently in header of the palette. Also show live brief metrics under each preset (eg soft: -8% cost, quarantine: +30% invokes).
kat: Two enforcement items: 1) require a short justification when changing severity or picking 'divert' and 2) show which signals matched at the time the palette was suggested. Add a small "matched snapshot" link.
omar: On telemetry/infra: we should emit a deterministic breadcrumb like palette:20260322T101530:rollout-99 and include a snapshot token (tb-20260322-11). The audit log needs actor, mode, duration, reason, breadcrumb, and snapshot.
arian: agreed. mock control set: grid of 4 presets (icons + name + estimated deltas), duration presets on hover, optional 'attach repro' toggle for prompt-related matches, and an escalate confirm modal when severity changes.
pavel: UX nit: show an undo tether after apply (a small floating pill "undo (120s)"). clicking undo writes a revert audit row and attempts a clean rollback. Also rate-limit applies/reverts per rollout to avoid flip-flopping.
sara: Let's include estimated uncertainty (eg +/-5%) on deltas. Operators need to know noise. Also permission gating: only contingency.write roles can pick 'divert' or 'fallback-model'. Disabled states with tooltip.
kat: Example audit payload (for engineers):```{
  "event":"palette.apply",
  "actor":"arian",
  "rollout":"rollout-99",
  "route":"/v1/chat/completions",
  "mode":"divert",
  "duration":"60s",
  "reason":"safety classifier spike in eu-west",
  "breadcrumb":"palette:20260322T101530:rollout-99",
  "snapshot":"tb-20260322-11"
}```
omar: Important infra detail: breadcrumb ids must be deterministic (timestamp + rollout) so the decision-sim and forensic exporter can find the exact event. Avoid random UUIDs. Also persist sampled snapshots for 72h for postmortems.
arian: Add a small "preview traces" link in the palette that opens the matched snapshot in the trace viewer. Good for quick triage.
pavel: For the palette UI, sort presets by expected risk reduction and surface the top suggestion with a subtle highlight and a confidence pill. If confidence is low, require extra confirm.
sara: Process note: auto-suggest vs auto-apply. I vote only suggest by default; allow auto-apply with a 10s confirmation countdown when confidence high and permission present. No silent auto-runs.
kat: Also track who viewed the palette and which preset was hovered (for UX analytics). Tiny event: palette.view with route + matched snapshot id.
omar: ops-bot: deploy preview?
ops-bot: Preview: https://console-preview.internal/quick-palette?pr=1752  simulated signals included.
arian: I'll write the RFC with mocks, telemetry contract (breadcrumb + snapshot token), event schema, undo/rate-limits, permission matrix, and preview link. Thanks all :thumbsup:
